name: Amayadoru Tsuka no Ma no Koto
source:
Suddenly we are caught in the rain. We have to take shelter from the rain for a while. Let's pass the time by talking!

[From [url=https://p6ik.itch.io/amayadoru]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
突然我们被雨淋湿了。我们得暂时避雨。让我们通过聊天来打发时间吧！

[来自[url=https://p6ik.itch.io/amayadoru]Itch.io[/url]]
